note: Captured runs. Each entry is one rfd4-generate run exported by workflow/export_playback.py. Every run here is against one of the two targets the BindCraft2 site also uses, so the two tools can be compared on the same structures.

binder_3evg.title: A binder against 3EVG
binder_3evg.what: The same dengue-2 NS5 methyltransferase the BindCraft2 site uses, run unguided so the model picks its own epitope. Thirty two designs, and the oracle likes none of them.
binder_3evg.command: rfd4-generate inputs=/home/bgeiss/rfd4-visualizer-runs/inputs/binder_3evg.yaml out_dir=/home/bgeiss/rfd4-visualizer-runs/binder_3evg num_replicates=32 seed=1234 metrics_tags='[ppi_refolding]' metrics/refolding_oracles=af2 generation.args.save_trajectory_every=2 generation.args.bb_ca_only_trajectories=false generation.args.dump_noisy_trajectories=true

binder_il15_faceA.title: IL-15 Face A
binder_il15_faceA.what: IL-15, aimed at the epitope BindCraft2 designed against successfully. One design here reaches an interface the oracle finds plausible.

binder_il15_faceB.title: IL-15 Face B
binder_il15_faceB.what: IL-15, aimed at the face BindCraft2 scored zero of two hundred against. Same model, same budget, same protein: only the epitope changed.
